title: Interlaced stars of the Sala de la Barca (Alhambra)
subtitle: Sala de la Barca, Alhambra

construction.note: The finished design was read from Brian Wichmann’s CM052 drawing. We devised the construction using the bath-star construction with changed corner squares. The reference does not supply this sequence of steps.
construction.changes: The app’s compass operations, step order and named intersections are our reconstruction. Recorded drawing and photo comparisons assess the finished line structure, not whether these were the historical construction steps.

given.O: The centre of a large star.
given.A: Halfway from O to the next large star along the axis.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A.

Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through A. Draw a vertical line through B. Draw a horizontal line through C. Draw a horizontal line through D. These lines cross at E, F, G and H. Draw a straight line through O and E. Draw a line through O at 90° to line OE. Draw a circle with centre O through E. It crosses the horizontal and vertical lines at J, K, L and N. Join J, K, L and N with straight lines.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through A. Draw a horizontal line through C. These lines cross at E. Draw a straight line through O and E. Draw a line through O at 90° to line OE. Draw a circle with centre O through E. It crosses the horizontal and vertical lines at J, K, L and N. Draw a straight line through J and K. Draw a straight line through K and L.

steps.text: Draw the line through O that halves the angle AOE.
Draw a straight line through E and D. It crosses the line that halves the angle AOE at Q. Draw a vertical line through Q. It crosses the horizontal line at S1. Draw a circle with centre O through S1.
Join S1, S3, S5 and S7 with straight lines. Join S2, S4, S6 and S8 with straight lines. S1 to S8 are where the circle through S1 crosses the lines through O. The two squares make the large star.

Draw a circle with centre R through S2. R is where the first circle crosses line OE. The new circle crosses line OE again at U. Draw a line through U parallel to the line from S2 to S4. It is a side of the next large star.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a circle with centre R through S2. R is where the first circle crosses line OE. The new circle crosses line OE again at U, the point of the next large star.

steps.text: Draw a circle with centre K whose radius is the distance from S2 to R. It carries the small square at K.

Draw a horizontal line through K. Join Q1, Q3, Q5 and Q7 with straight lines. Join Q2, Q4, Q6 and Q8 with straight lines. Q1 to Q8 are where the circle at K crosses the lines through K. The second square is the small square at K.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a horizontal line through K. Draw straight lines through Q2 and Q4, Q4 and Q6, Q6 and Q8, and Q8 and Q2. Q1 to Q8 are where the circle at K crosses the lines through K. These lines make the small square at K.

steps.text: Turn the lines of the small square, and the line through U, round O by 90°, three times. This copies them to J, L and N.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Turn the lines of the small square round O by 90°, three times. This copies them to J, L and N.

steps.text: Draw a line through V1 parallel to line KL. Draw a line through V1 parallel to line JK. Draw a line through V2 parallel to line KL. Draw a line through V2 parallel to line JK. V1 and V2 are where the sides of the small square cross the horizontal line through K. Turn these four lines round O by 90°, three times.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a line through V1 parallel to line KL. Draw a line through V1 parallel to line JK. Draw a line through V2 parallel to line KL. V1 and V2 are where the sides of the small square cross the horizontal line through K. Turn these lines round O by 90°, three times. Only the lines the pattern needs are shown.

steps.text: Mark each point where a band turns, crosses another or ends.
Join J, K, L and N to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the bands. They run round each large star and round each small square, and cross between them.

parts.text: Ink from S3 through P6 to S2, then on to P3 and S1. These lines make one point of the large star.
Ink from S2 through P4 and P2 to P1. Ink from S2 through P5, P7 and Q8 to Q6. These are the bands from that point.
Ink the same lines turned round O, three more times. Tick “Also ink the copies round the centre” to ink them all at once.

pattern.text: Put copies of the square cell side by side. Large stars sit on the grid, and a small square where four cells touch. The bands weave between them.
